note: Top navigation bar -- renders: skip link, logo, search bar, Help, Network, Log in, Sign up
Site header -- renders: site name/logo
Left sidebar navigation -- renders: Home, Questions, Unanswered, Ask, Tags, Users, Companies, Chat, SOFA, and promotional CTA text
Question header controls -- renders: 'Ask Question' button; question title is user-generated and subtracted
Question metadata row -- renders: 'Asked', 'Modified', 'Viewed' labels and timestamps
Question metadata row -- renders: 'Active' label and timestamp
Answers header -- renders: 'Answers' heading, 'Sorted by' label, and sort dropdown options
Ad report control -- renders: 'Report this ad' button
Post action links -- renders: 'Share', 'Improve this question/answer', 'Follow' buttons
User action timestamp -- renders: 'asked'/'modified'/'answered' label and relative time
User avatar -- renders: user profile image
User flair -- renders: reputation score and user badge icons
Comments toggle -- renders: 'Add a comment' or 'Show N comments' button
Comment score -- renders: vote count for the comment
Comment user attribution -- renders: user display name link
Comment timestamp -- renders: 'edited'/'commented' label and relative time
Site footer -- renders: navigation links (Tour, Help, About, etc.), social links, and copyright text
Sidebar section header -- renders: 'Linked' heading
Sidebar section header -- renders: 'Related' heading
Feed link -- renders: 'Feed' link
Sidebar widget headers -- renders: 'Top Network Questions', 'Linked Questions', 'Related Questions' headings
Bottom notice heading -- renders: 'Your Answer' or similar platform prompt
Post notice -- renders: platform informational message about posting
Answer form label -- renders: 'Your Answer' or similar static label
Answer form description -- renders: static instructional text for answering
Answer start button -- renders: 'Start Answering' or similar CTA
Answer form label -- renders: 'Tags' or similar static label
Answer form description -- renders: static instructional text for tags
